bio.text: Jessica Killin is the Democratic Party candidate for Colorado's 5th Congressional District in the 2026 general election.

According to her campaign website, she was raised in Colorado Springs, graduated from Falcon High School, and attended college on a Reserve Officers' Training Corps scholarship before serving in the U.S. Army as a Captain and Military Police Officer.
Her campaign website says she earned a law degree at Georgetown, worked for more than a decade as an executive at USAA, and later held leadership roles on Capitol Hill and at the White House.
